text:
Skill

管理可在对话中复用的指令。

Ask Memory
已添加

Reads and changes what Phi remembers about the user, and the surfaces Phi builds from that memory. Use whenever the user asks an open question about themselves (what they have been working on or reading, how an interest developed, everything remembered about a person, trip or plan of theirs), tells Phi something lasting to remember about them or corrects it, asks Phi to forget something, gives the assistant a standing instruction about how to behave ("be more concise from now on"; not how a task or watch the user set up runs or reports, which changes that task), states a lasting preference about a memory-built surface (the new-tab greetings, the insight, the proactive or artifact suggestions, their profile), or asks to regenerate, refresh or restyle one of those surfaces. Including equivalent requests in any language. NOT for a quick fact the assistant can recall while replying, for the page the user has open, for general knowledge, or for anything to be done on the web.

Detect Page Tech Stack
添加

Detects which web technologies the user's current page uses — frameworks, web servers, runtimes, analytics, CDNs, edge networks, payments, CMS, monitoring, ads, fonts, and more. Inspects both client-side DOM signals and server-side HTTP response headers, cookies, and URL path patterns. Returns a categorized list to chat. Use whenever the user asks "what is this site built with", "what framework does this page use", "show the tech stack", "detect the tech", "Wappalyzer this page", "what analytics does this site run", "what server is this running on", or similar inspection requests about the current page.

Download Twitter Video
添加

Download videos or animated GIFs from the currently open X or Twitter post as MP4 files, choosing the highest-bitrate available MP4. Use when the user asks to download or save a Twitter/X video. Operates on the active post, not an entire timeline, account, or a link that has not been opened.

Explain Page Simply
添加

Rewrites the user's currently open web page in plain language for a non-expert reader — expands jargon, uses everyday analogies, preserves all substantive claims but drops industry shorthand. Use whenever the user asks to "explain this simply", "ELI5 this page", explain like I'm five, dumb this down, make this accessible, or break down the technical concepts on the page. Including equivalent requests in any language.

Export ChatGPT Conversation
添加

Export the user's currently open ChatGPT conversation (text, images, audio, code, project / custom-gpt membership) and import it into the local /v1/chats list.

Extract Action Items
添加

Pulls concrete action items, TODOs, follow-ups, and next steps from the user's currently open page, but only when the page contains explicit actionable signals such as assigned tasks, requests, deadlines, checklists, issue details, review feedback, or follow-up instructions. Refuses cleanly for news articles, blog posts, product pages, tutorials, reference docs, and other descriptive pages that do not contain real tasks. Use whenever the user asks to list TODOs, action items, next steps, follow-ups, tasks, "what do I need to do", or extract tasks from the current page. Including equivalent requests in any language.

Fact-Check Page
添加

Extracts specific verifiable factual claims from the user's currently open web page and checks them against independent sources. Reports a clear verdict for each claim with supporting sources. Use whenever the user asks to fact-check, verify, cross-check, validate, check whether something on the page is true, or find sources for claims on the current page. Including equivalent requests in any language.

Reader Mode
添加

Show the user's current web page in a clean, distraction-free reading overlay. Strips navigation, ads, sidebars, and footers. Use whenever the user asks for reader mode, reading mode, immersive reading, distraction-free view, or wants to focus on just the article text of the page they are viewing, including equivalent requests in any language. Calling the skill while the overlay is already open collapses it; calling it again re-opens. After the first invocation a small Phi-branded button stays anchored to the bottom-right so the user can toggle reader mode without re-invoking the skill.

Save Page as PDF
添加

Export the user's current browser tab to a PDF file. Use only when the user explicitly wants a PDF; do not use for PNG, image, or screenshot requests.

Save Page as Screenshot
添加

Export the user's current browser tab as a single full-page PNG screenshot, including the parts hidden below the fold. Use when the user asks to save, export, capture, or screenshot the current page, current tab, or page they are viewing as an image, including in any language.

Show Page as Markdown
添加

Renders the main article of the user's current web page as Markdown directly in chat, with metadata frontmatter (title, URL, byline). The output is shown verbatim in the chat reply — it is NOT saved to disk or to the file store. Use whenever the user asks to view the current page as Markdown, get a Markdown copy of the article they are reading, convert the current page to Markdown, or render a clean plain-text version of the article. Including equivalent requests in any language.

Show Page QR Code
添加

Shows a QR code overlay for the user's current browser page URL. Use this skill whenever the user asks to show, display, pop up, or generate a QR code for the current page, current tab, or current URL.

Video Gist
已添加

Understands a video's actual content and turns it into the text the user asks for — YouTube videos via server-side Gemini video ingestion (speech and visuals), bilibili videos via the site's subtitle tracks or a transcription of the audio track. Supports ONLY YouTube and bilibili; other video sites are not supported. Use whenever the user wants to transcribe a video into readable text, summarize a video, extract its key points or takeaways, or convert it into an article, blog post, or written guide — for the YouTube or bilibili video their current tab IS, or a video link they typed themselves. NOT for summarizing an ordinary web page or article that merely embeds, links, or transcribes a video: that is a page task, and the page's own text is the material. Including equivalent requests in any language.
